label: FP
reason: The user-provided value is only used in the conditional assignment to bar, which defaults to param when the guard condition fails. However, the guard condition (7*42 - num > 200) evaluates to true (since 7*42=294, minus num=86 gives 208, which is greater than 200), so bar is always assigned the constant value "This_should_always_happen" and never receives the user input. Thus, the user-controlled data does not reach the sink where it would be rendered in HTML.

evidence.note: Guard condition always true, so param is never used
